name: Wasp_Basic Part
brief: Wasp_Basic Part | Inputs: NAME, GEO, CONN, COLL, ATTR → PART
context: Wasp plugin component: creates a WaspPart object â€” the fundamental building block for discrete aggregation. Requires a unique name string, geometry, and connection objects.
solution_principle: Create a WaspPart from a name string, geometry (Brep/Mesh), and WaspConnection objects. The NAME string is critical â€” it must exactly match what Wasp_Rule references in P1/P2. The same Brep feeds both this component's GEO and ConnDir's GEO. COLL is optional collision geometry for overlap checking. ATTR carries additional data through aggregation.
anti_patterns: Part name mismatch with Wasp_Rule P1/P2 silently breaks rule matching
Using different geometry for ConnDir.GEO and Part.GEO causes misaligned connections
preconditions: WaspConnection objects from Wasp_Connection From Direction
Unique name string for the part type
